annotations.title: Prepare an order for the user to review

description: Show the user an order to review: items, what it will cost and the hold on the card. This does NOT place the order or spend anything — the user places it by clicking Pay & place in the card that appears, and enters their shipping address on the payment page that opens. Use this whenever the user wants to buy something; never ask them for an address first. Pass each product's title, image and price_cents from search so the card shows the item and quotes the total; leave max_price out unless the user named a budget. address_id, from list-addresses, is only for a signed-in user shipping somewhere they have shipped before. Not sold through this connector: weapons, tobacco and nicotine, regulated drugs and paraphernalia, prescription medication, adult products, gambling, covert surveillance and counterfeit goods. An order for one of those is refused.

address_id.description: An id from list-addresses, for a signed-in user shipping somewhere they have shipped before. Resolved against their own order history; the full address appears in the review card, not here. Leave it out otherwise: the shopper enters the address on the payment page. Never ask for an address in the conversation.

max_price.description: Hard spending cap for this order, in cents, including tax and shipping. Pass it only when the user named a budget; otherwise leave it out and the cap is derived from the listed price, an estimated tax and shipping, with a margin. The order fails rather than exceeding it.

image.description: Product image URL, copied verbatim from the search result. Only an address search returned can be shown — a constructed or substituted one is dropped rather than rendered.

price_cents.description: Listed unit price from search, in cents. Drives the quote and the cap.

title.description: Product title from search, for the card.

url.description: Product URL on the retailer's site

name: prepare-order

can_place.description: False when this connection lacks the orders:write scope.

guest.description: True when nobody is signed in: the order belongs to a guest account made from the checkout email rather than to a Zinc account.

image.description: Product image URL, copied verbatim from the search result. Only an address search returned can be shown — a constructed or substituted one is dropped rather than rendered.

price_cents.description: Listed unit price from search, in cents. Drives the quote and the cap.

title.description: Product title from search, for the card.

url.description: Product URL on the retailer's site

cap_basis.description: derived: the cap is the estimate plus a margin; budget: it is the max_price the user named.

estimated_total_cents.description: What the card will most likely be charged: goods + tax + shipping + fee.

hold_cents.description: Authorized on the card: max_price + fee.

shipping_basis.description: member: ships free at any size on this connector; free_over_threshold: the basket clears the retailer's free-shipping line; standard: the retailer's ground charge applies.

tax_basis.description: Always 'assumed' here: a flat 10% estimate, not a rate lookup.

tax_rate.description: The rate the tax ESTIMATE used, as a decimal. Not a lookup: the destination is not known until checkout, so a flat 10% is assumed and the retailer charges the real tax. It only sizes the hold; only the actual total is ever captured.

ship_to_summary.description: Empty when the shopper will enter the address on the payment page.

shipping_address.description: Only when resolved from a saved address; otherwise entered at checkout.
